reason: NONE. First thing I saw was $29.99 for 30 sachets, which is about $1 a serving when Nature Made or Double Wood cost 20 to 40 cents. A QR lab report is nice, but it is not an NSF or USP seal, and a new brand with zero reviews is not something I put my $32k budget on.
objection: Triple the price per serving of brands I already trust, no reviews to read, and no NSF or USP seal. A QR code from the brand's own chosen lab is not the same as a third-party certification.
would_change_my_mind: Price near $15 for 30 servings, plus an NSF or USP seal and a few hundred honest verified reviews.
